_about: Each flavor's short code and pattern (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.5). Its name is in the copy file under flavors.<id>, its fill in palette.json under flavors.<id>. The order here is the flavor's number in sim. `mass` and `gravity_pct` say how heavy its slush is (default 1 and 100): raspberry is the heavy one (Sam, 2026-10-06: "a slush type that is super heavy").
